{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Tall beige trench coat, straight cut, knee-length, beige (#D2B48C), wool blend with a cotton lining.
Slim-leg dark indigo jeans, tapered leg, ankle length, deep navy blue (#0F172A), heavy stretch denim.
Structured cream blouse, relaxed fit, elbow length, off-white (#FFFDD0), fine poplin cotton.
White leather sneakers, classic low-top design, medium length, pure white (#FFFFFF), smooth nubuck and rubber sole.

This outfit perfectly balances comfort and style for an autumn city stroll at +10 °C, offering warmth without feeling bulky. The dark indigo jeans provide a polished base that elevates the casual nature of the walk, while the cream blouse adds a touch of lightness against the cooler weather. A beige trench coat shields against the chill and wind typical of early autumn days, completing the look with neutral tones that blend seamlessly with any urban backdrop."}
